desc.en: Baqi is having an eventful history and a large number of holy warriors are buried therein. These include those who were injured during the Battle of Ohod but they achieved martyrdom after returning to Medina. Then they were buried in Baqi.
desc.rurdu: Baqi mein kaafi tadaad mein taariqi jang-ju dafn hai. Is mein Jang-e-Ohad ke zakhmi momeneen jo Madina pohonchne ke baad unki shahadat huwi. Woh bhi is Baqi mein dafn hai.

title.urdu: بقی میں واقعۃ حرہ کے شہداء

desc.en: The martyrs of the Event of Hurrah are also buried in Baqi. After the tragedy of Karbala and the martyrdom of Imam Hussain (a) and his companions, the people of Madina revolted against the Umayyad rule and dethroned the governor of Madina. Yazid sent a large army to suppress the revolt and his army plundered Madina for 3 days continuously, killing people and looting their property and the honor of their women. Thousands perished in this attack including 80 companions of the Holy Prophet (s) and 700 children of the Ansaar and Mohajereen (Helpers and Emigrants). This incident is famous as "Hurrah". The martyrs of this attack are buried in Baqi.
desc.rurdu: Waqeya Hurrah ke shaheed bhi is Baqi mein dafn hai. Karbala ke waaqye aur Imam Husain (a) aur unke saathiyo’n ki shahadat ke baad, Madine ke logo’n ne bani ummayya ke khilaaf awaaz uthaayi aur Madine ke governer ko wahan se hata diya. Is par Yazid ne ek bada lashkar Madine ki taraf rawaana kiya jo Madine waalo’n ka 3 din tak qatle aam, loot aur aurto’n ki izzat ko pa-maal kiya. Hazaaro’n ki tadaad mein log is hamle mein shaheed huwe jis mein Rasool (s) ke 80 sahaabi bhi thay aur 700 Ansaar aur Mohajereen ke bachche bhi thay. Yeh waqya “Hurrah” ke naam se mashhoor hai. Is waqye mein jo shaheed huwe, woh bhi is Baqi mein dafn hai.

desc.en: Recite the Ziyarat of the martyrs of Ohod and the event of Hurrah in the following manner…
desc.rurdu: Ohad aur Waaqye Hurrah ke shaheedo’n ki ziyarat is tarah se padhe…
desc.urdu: اُحد اور واقعۃ حرہ کے شہداء کی زیارت۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا شُہْدَآئُ یَا سُعَدَآئُ یَا نُجَبَآئُ یَا نُقَبَآئُ یَا اَھْلَ الصِّدْقِ وَالْوَفَآئِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا مُجَاہِدُوْنَ فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللہِ حَقَّ جِہَادِہٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَی الدَّارِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا شُہْدَآئُ كَآفَّۃً عَآمَّۃً وَرَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَبَرَكَاتُہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA SHOHADAAA-O YAA SO-A’A-DAAA-O YAA NOJABAAA-O YAA NOQABAAA-O YAA AHLAS SIDQE WAL-WAFAAA-E ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA MOJAAHEDOONA FEE SABEELIL LAAHE HAQQA JEHAADEHI ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM BEMAA SABARTUM FA-NE’MA U’QBAD DAARE ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA SHO-HADAAA-O KAAAFFATAN AAAMMATAN WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.urdu: اس کے بعد <اسماعیل ابن جعفرؑ> کی زیارت پڑھے۔
